title: Institution data refresh audit
scope: Read-only audit of current pipeline logic, curated affiliation mappings, institution aliases, local OpenAlex snapshot, and checked-in aggregate/site metadata.
No normalizers were run. No files outside this report and JSON proposal were changed.

method.repository_instructions: No repository-local AGENTS.md or SKILL.md was found.
method.work_cache_policy: Inspected file signatures before parsing. 767 of 775 cache/**/works.jsonl files are Git LFS pointer stubs; only 8 contain materialized data. Cache contents were not used as publication data.
method.source_hierarchy: data/institutions.json is treated as the local authoritative OpenAlex snapshot for exact OpenAlex ID/name/type/country comparisons. Official institutional websites were used for live name and location verification. A live OpenAlex API singleton response was not available through the browser tool for most proposed ID corrections; exact replacement OpenAlex IDs therefore come from the local snapshot and should be rechecked against live OpenAlex/ROR before applying.

snapshot_comparison.note: A matching country on the same ID does not establish that the affiliation-map institution_name is correctly attached to that ID. Eight severe identity conflicts are itemized below; several other name differences are spelling, canonical-name, or old-name variants.

severe_manual_identity_conflicts.summary: The manually assigned raw affiliation/name conflicts with the organization represented by its OpenAlex ID. The cache files needed to isolate the credit attributable to individual map rows are LFS pointers. The destination IDs' aggregate totals are reported only as context and must not be read as affected credit.

repeated_canonical_targets.review_note: Generic name plus same country is insufficient evidence that five Government Medical College records are the same campus. Keep these five edges provisional until exact ROR/OpenAlex records or addresses establish identity.

alias_audit.runtime_behavior: aggregate.py performs a single exact-string alias lookup. The four bare source IDs will not match fully-qualified source IDs in works. No current aggregate row uses any duplicate source ID, so the current output does not quantify impact of these four formatting cases.
alias_audit.country_conflict_note: All 69 alias country fields agree with the local snapshot country for their canonical target. The 60 duplicate source IDs absent from the local snapshot cannot be independently country-checked from this snapshot.

limitations: The checked-in aggregate is a derived snapshot; 767 of 775 work-cache files are LFS pointers in this checkout, so the underlying works and current raw affiliation resolutions could not be independently reconstructed.
No normalizer or aggregation command was run because the user warned that normalizers can overwrite manual decisions and the parent owns integration.
The OpenAlex institution snapshot is local and may lag live records; it supports identity and country comparisons only for IDs it contains.

Country on a campus/subunit record is a geography label, not a proposal to merge the campus into its parent university. No historical author affiliation is inferred from current institutional metadata.
